title: cc-insights CLI 宣传片
description: 43s 终端风宣传片：痛点证据→finding→rec/tok/cmd/web 快速下钻→AI 可消费输出→CTA。

env.fonts: local: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font + Noto Sans CJK SC (零联网)
env.audio_voice: mmx Chinese (Mandarin)_Male_Announcer / speech-2.8-hd, public/script-52s.txt → voiceover-52s.mp3/srt，实际语音 42.6s
env.audio_bgm: mix-cc-insights-52s.m4a 内含人声+BGM，render-final.sh 按视频长度 trim 到 43.17s
env.audio_captions: voiceover-52s.srt / KaraokeCaptions 保留给可选字幕版；主推版不挂载全片字幕

renders.command: TS=20260704-ccopt END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
TS=20260704-manim2 END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized

renders.command: TS=20260704-nocaptions END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
renders.captions: disabled in CCInsightsPromo to keep Manim titles and screenshot annotations clean

renders.command: TS=20260704-cutfix2 END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
fixes: rec -> tok uses a hard cut instead of crossfade to avoid stacking two dense UI scenes
SceneRec masks the lower Manim metrics rail so the 20s frame only carries the core four-step chain

reproduce.still_check: render-final.sh auto extracts frames 20, 7s, middle, 3/4, final

notes: 2026-07-04 优化：总长 52.7s→43.17s，按 voiceover-52s.srt 重排场景起点，并给 tok/web 截图增加焦点标注。Manim 混合版把 hook 的 JSONL→finding 和 rec 的证据链预渲染为本地 mp4，再用 Remotion Video 嵌入；试过 OffthreadVideo，但本地渲染吞吐明显偏低，因此改用 Video。无字幕主推版移除全片顶部 KaraokeCaptions，避免和 Manim 标题、截图标注争夺顶部层级；SRT/组件保留给可选 captioned 版本。20-21s 修复：rec→tok 改硬切，rec 底部拥挤指标 rail 用面板内遮罩压掉，只保留核心四段链路。durationInFrames = Σ场景1355 − Σ转场60 = 1295。配色/缓动/字体常量在 src/theme.ts。
